description: This PHP source file defines the ExtensionManager class responsible for managing and compiling extension files within the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for handling authentication, initializing module lists, compiling extension files for modules and applications, and managing file operations.

classes.name: ExtensionManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing and compiling extension files in SuiteCRM, including handling authentication, initialization, and file operations for module and application extensions.

methods.name: handleAuth
methods.description: Checks if the script is accessed through a valid entry point; terminates execution if not.

methods.name: initialise
methods.description: Initializes the module list and logger.

methods.name: compileExtensionFiles
methods.description: Main method to compile extension files for a given extension, with options for filtering and application-only compilation.

methods.name: compileApplicationExtensions
methods.description: Compiles application extension files for a specific extension and target filename.

methods.name: compileModuleExtensions
methods.description: Compiles module extension files for all modules in the module list for a specific extension and target filename.

methods.name: removePhpTagsFromString
methods.description: Removes PHP tags from a string of PHP code.

methods.name: shouldSkipFile
methods.description: Determines whether a file should be skipped based on its name, type, and filter.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves extension content to a specified file path.

methods.name: unlinkFile
methods.description: Deletes a specified extension file if it exists.
